verdict.rationale: Grok is operated through natural-language chat and voice. First-party docs show chat commands that act on connected tools: creating Salesforce records, sending Teams messages, managing Drive files, and handing work to Grok Bot. Community feedback is mixed: one hands-on user praised how much it intuits, while another reported trouble with agentic tool calling on Grok 4. Missing for 10: natural-language control of product settings and admin (billing and workspace management are documented as UI flows), and consistent independent corroboration of reliable agentic action execution.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Connect your tools so Grok can reach your email, files, and calendar right inside a chat.

Talk to Grok hands-free with voice.
